pages.image_type: color photograph with digital annotation overlay
pages.description: A photograph of a barren lunar-like surface under a very dark greenish-black sky. The foreground shows a gray, cratered and rippled ground with scattered rocks, and the long dark shadow of a person (photographer) cast across the terrain toward the viewer. Small cross-shaped reticle marks (fiducial crosses) are distributed across the scene, indicating a Hasselblad camera frame. The horizon is bright with a diffuse glow near its center. In the upper portion of the frame, a small bright point of light appears in the sky just above the horizon, enclosed by a small yellow square; two yellow lines connect it to a larger yellow-bordered inset box in the upper center, which shows a magnified, grainy view of the point of light resolving into a white dot with a faint red spot above it against the dark noisy background.
